accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label's text content names the control through aria-labelledby, set on the control (see association rules).
aria: association: for=<id> (or a wrapped control) finds the control in the label's own tree scope; the click is forwarded to it (focus, then click for non-text controls)

naming: the label gets an id if it has none and the control gets aria-labelledby with that id, appended to any value the author set and removed when the label goes away, changes target or the control is replaced

shadow DOM: ID references do not cross shadow roots (SB-0009), so naming reaches a control only if its host is the element carrying the role or the native control in the same tree (native input, or a host with its own role); a sb-* control that renders its input inside a shadow root is named by its own label prop, and sb-label then only forwards clicks and adds the visual label
ElementInternals.labels lists native label elements only: sb-label is not one, so a form-associated control's labels collection does not include it
not focusable itself; clicks on links or buttons inside the label are not forwarded
accessibility.role: none on the host: the name is delivered to the control, not announced as a role
accessibility.targetSize: Click area is the label box; the control keeps its own target size.

antiPatterns.alternative: Use sb-input's label prop; use sb-label only for controls without one
antiPatterns.why: sb-input already renders its own label

antiPatterns.alternative: Put label and control in the same tree, or wrap the control

antiPatterns.why: IDs only resolve in the label's own tree

antiPatterns.pattern: Placeholder text instead of a label

useCases.use: sb-label for=<id>; the control is named and clickable through the label

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Wrapper around the default slot; icons or other inline content sit beside the text.

default.notes: The label text, optionally with an icon, or a control to wrap. Interactive content such as a link keeps its own behavior.

openQuestions.answer: As described in accessibility.aria: for or nesting, click forwarding, aria-labelledby on same-tree targets; sb-* controls with an inner shadow input are named by their own label.
openQuestions.question: How does sb-label associate with a control, given IDREFs do not cross shadow roots?
openQuestions.recommendation: Behavior-based: resolve the target in the label's own tree scope (for id, or the first control inside), forward clicks, and set aria-labelledby on the target so native controls and role-bearing hosts get a real name. Shadow-wrapped sb-* controls keep their own label prop.

openQuestions.question: Should the label mirror the control's disabled state?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: reading another element's state needs observers and the author knows it; expose a disabled prop instead.

disabled.note: Dims the label and stops it forwarding clicks. Set it when the labelled control is disabled; the label does not read the control's state.

htmlFor.note: The id of the control to label, looked up in the same document or shadow tree as the label. Without it, the first control inside the label is used.

disabled.note: Dims the label and stops it forwarding clicks.

contract.summary: A stand-alone text label for a control: it forwards clicks to the control and, where the platform allows, names it.

# Plan: Label (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
`sb-label`: slotted text, `for` and wrapping association, click forwarding, `aria-labelledby` naming on same-tree controls, `disabled`. Out of scope: required indicator, mirroring the control's state, naming controls inside other shadow roots.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/label/Label.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/label/label.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/label/Label.scss` -> `Label.styles.ts` (generated) |
| 4 | `src/components/label/Label.ts`, `index.ts` |

No new semantic tokens.

## Test plan (test-first)
- Look from tokens (flex, size, weight, line height, color, gap); icon beside text.
- `for` + native checkbox: click toggles it; `for` + native text input: click focuses it; wrapped control works.
- `for` + sb-input (form-associated, shadow input): click focuses the inner input.
- A role-bearing custom host is named by the label and toggled by clicking it.
- Native input gets its accessible name; existing aria-labelledby is kept; cleanup when `for` changes or the label is removed; control that appears after the label.
- Disabled dims and stops forwarding; links inside are not forwarded; not focusable; axe clean.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
The visual reference gets naming from a native label element; sb-label cannot be one, so it names through aria-labelledby (same tree only). Documented in the contract's association rules.

## Open questions (recommendation first)
Both answered in contract.json (behavior-based association; disabled as a prop).
